title: Square AND Cube? | AMC 8-Style Level 4
description:
Twenty times n is a perfect square, and fifty times n is a perfect cube. What is the smallest n? Vantee solves it two ways: first by making a list, then by counting the copies of each prime. Then try a variant yourself!
